actions.description: Keep running; release all keys (also ends a jump early for a shorter hop)
Jump, or start/restart the game; holding it on following ticks makes the jump higher
Duck under low-flying birds; in the air it makes the dino drop fast

notes: Heights are measured up from the ground line, which comes from the ground sprite (y+h+1 ≈ 140). An obstacle's 'bottom' > 0 means it floats: duck if bottom is about 20–30 and it is at head height, run under it if it is high, otherwise jump when dx is small (around 60–120, more as the game speeds up). Speed can't be read from a single frame, so derive it outside the extractor from how much dx changes between ticks. Unseen sprites (including rects) are reported as 'unknown' obstacles. Bird, ducking and 2/3-cactus labels are inferred from the standard Chrome sprite sheet and were not in the sample.
